evidence.quote: an ingot of Fe50Mn30Co10Cr10 (at. %) composition was produced by the arc melting method in a vacuum arc melter (VAM) with a water-cooled Cu crucible... the Ar supply was throttled to maintain a constant working pressure of 12 torr (absolute)... at an operating current of 150 A
The as-cast ingots were hot-rolled at 900 ◦C to reduce the thickness of the specimen, followed by water quenching.

The samples were subsequently annealed at 1200 ◦C for holding time of 2, 12, 24, and 48 h in an alumina tube furnace followed by water quenching... All heat treatments were performed under an Ar atmosphere.
